tts/out/pens2/01.mp3: Setting up a company pension in Trinidad has always meant piles of forms, a calculator, and weeks of chasing. We've taken all of that away.
tts/out/pens2/02.mp3: We've always kept our clients records in order with strong systems like Salesforce. Now artificial intelligence helps us get better every week.
tts/out/pens2/03.mp3: It starts with you, the employer. Sign in with your company code and see everyone on your plan and where each one stands.
tts/out/pens2/04.mp3: to add someone fill in the company's part, the plan, the premium, and their salary. Press send, and we write to your employee.
tts/out/pens2/05.mp3: They get their own link by email. Until their part is in, we remind them every morning and you're copied on every message.
tts/out/pens2/06.mp3: On their phone, they add what only they can give, who the money goes to anything of their own and photos of three documents. It takes about 10 minutes.

tts/out/pens2/10.mp3: Then every form fills itself. The inland revenue approval request, declaration 1, declaration 2, and the salary deduction form. Guardians own forms, filled in exactly.
tts/out/pens2/11.mp3: It all comes together in one package and our branch checks every page before it goes to head office.
tts/out/pens2/12.mp3: You get your own copy by email, ready to print, sign, stamp, and send. Nothing to retype, and nothing to chase.
tts/out/pens2/13.mp3: and everyone can see where it stands. You, your employee and our team, all the way to the policy being issued.
